protocol.coldBoot: Each run uses a new browser context with an empty context cache.
protocol.warmBoot: The same page is reloaded in the same context after its cold boot.
protocol.stress: Actual Game.start, Squad.setCount and EnemyManager.spawnEnemy APIs; fixed 60 enemies; paused simulation with active RAF rendering prevents deaths/spawns from changing actor counts.
protocol.interpretation: Comparative Windows Edge headless desktop evidence only; not a real mobile or WeChat-device benchmark.
